get.summary: Computes current counts and actual applied-event history within an audited scope.

A case whose history cannot support a measure (a source timestamp earlier than the screening result, or a
treatment plan without its deadline) is left out of that measure's numerator and denominator and logged,
so one inconsistent case never stops the Impact screen for every reader.

get.summary: Describes what the CareLoop FHIR boundary supports.
get.description:
Lists one entry per registered IFhirInboundMapper (create and update) plus read on
`Task`, so the statement can never drift from what the endpoints accept.

200.description: 200 with a FHIR R4 `CapabilityStatement` listing the supported resource types and interactions.

get.summary: Returns the current status of a case as a FHIR `Task`; also feeds the patient view.
get.description:
Field mapping: handoff status to `Task.status`; stage to `Task.businessStatus`; owner to
`Task.owner`; who handed over to `Task.requester`; the result or referral to `Task.focus`;
patient to `Task.for`; deadline to `Task.restriction.period`; rejection or closure reason to
`Task.statusReason`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CareLoop's case identifier, used as the logical identifier of the case `Task`.

post.summary: Accepts a new FHIR resource from an external system.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The FHIR resource type in the URL, for example `DiagnosticReport`; must match the body.

put.summary: Accepts a new version of an existing FHIR resource from an external system.
put.description: An update is state, not an event: the mapper derives the transition and the resource version makes a resend idempotent.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The FHIR resource type in the URL; must match the body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The logical identifier of the resource; must match the body.

approvedText.description: The text being approved. The approver may have edited the draft; what is approved is exactly this text.

acknowledged.description: `true` when the patient said she will come: an acknowledgement.

understood.description: `true` when the patient said the next step back in her own words (teach-back).

confidence.description: How confident the patient said she feels about what happens next, from 1 to 5; `null` when she was not asked or gave no rating.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due.

outcomeEvidenceReference.description: Reference to the recorded outcome evidence, when there is any. `null` for the coordinator, who sees no one's identity.

oneOf.description: The reason the case was closed; `null` while it is open.

CaseDetailResponse.description: The full coordination state of one case, returned by `GET /cases/{caseId}`.

CaseDisplayLabel.description:
The ten labels the screen designs show for where a case is, computed from the five
CaseStage values plus the track statuses (decisions 1 and 19).

CaseEventType.description: The kinds of event that can change a case.

CaseStage.description: The pathway stage a case is in.

patientReference.description: Source-system reference of the patient. Never a name. `null` for the coordinator, who sees no one's identity.

patientDisplayName.description: Patient display name for staff; absent for a coordinator.

patientSecondaryIdentifier.description: Patient's second identifier for staff; absent for a coordinator.

facilityId.description: The case's facility, for audited team-scoped reads.

displayLabel.description: The display step derived by the Domain, never recomputed by the dashboard.

createdAt.description: When the result opened this case.

pathwayId.description: Identifier of the pathway the case follows.

stage.description: The pathway stage the case is in.

urgency.description: The clinician-reviewed urgency code; `null` until the review arrives.

owner.description: The one owner accountable for the next action.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due.

isEscalated.description: `true` while the case has an open escalation.

exceptions.description: Names of the unresolved exceptions on the case; empty when there are none.

CaseSummaryResponse.description: One row in the case list returned by `GET /cases`.

reason.description: The closure reason the rule applies to.

authorizedRoles.description: The role keys allowed to authorize closure for this reason.

isException.description: `true` when the reason is a documented exception rather than completed care.

requiresEvidenceReference.description: `true` when an outcome evidence reference must be present.

requiresExceptionNote.description: `true` when a written exception note must be present.

requiresNextSurveillanceDate.description: `true` when a next surveillance date must be present.

minimumDocumentedAttempts.description: The minimum number of documented contact attempts required; zero when none are needed.

citation.description: The clinical or policy source the evidence requirement is taken from, or `null` while it is a placeholder with no source.

nextAction.description: Key of the next action the deadline applies to, for example `acknowledge-notification`.

urgencyCode.description: The urgency code the deadline applies to, or `null` when it applies to every urgency.

duration.description: The time allowed from when the next action is set.

warnBefore.description: How long before the deadline the owner is warned.

clinicallyApproved.description: `true` once a clinical adviser has approved the value; `false` marks a placeholder.

ownerRole.description:
Role key of the person expected to own the case while this next action is open, for example

pathway does not say.

citation.description: The clinical or policy source the deadline is taken from, or `null` while it is a placeholder with no source.

DeadlineDefinition.description: How long one kind of next action may take, and who is expected to hold the case while it is open.

denominator.description: Number of eligible cases that reached the measured step.

median.description: Median duration, or null when the step has not been reached.

DurationMeasureResponse.description: Median elapsed clock time and the number of cases that reached that step.

escalationId.description: The specific escalation a person may acknowledge.

escalatedTo.description: The oversight role and facility queue addressed.

reason.description: The overdue action that prompted oversight.

acknowledgedBy.description: Who acknowledged it, when anyone has.

level.description: Position on the ladder; 1 is the first step.

clinicallyApproved.description: `true` once a clinical adviser has approved the value; `false` marks a placeholder.

kind.description: The code the outcome event carries, for example `treatment-plan`. Compared ignoring case.

description.description: What the kind means, for the programme screen.

nextAction.description:

EvidenceKindDefinition.description: One kind of outcome evidence the pathway recognises, and what recording it means for the case.

patientReference.description: Source-system reference of the patient. Never a name. `null` for the coordinator, who sees no one's identity.

patientDisplayName.description: Patient display name for staff; absent for a coordinator.

patientSecondaryIdentifier.description: Patient's second identifier for staff; absent for a coordinator.

displayLabel.description: The display step derived by the Domain.

exceptions.description: Names of the unresolved exceptions on the case.

stage.description: The pathway stage the case is in.

urgency.description: The clinician-reviewed urgency code; `null` until the review arrives.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action; `null` when the case has none, which should not happen on an open exception and is shown rather than hidden.

owner.description: The owner accountable for the next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due; `null` when the case has no deadline.

overdueBy.description: How long the next action is overdue; `null` when it is not overdue.

isEscalated.description: `true` while the case has an open escalation.

escalationLevel.description: The highest escalation level reached; zero when never escalated.

status.description: Where the summary stands with its reviewer.

sections.description: The sections of the summary, in reading order.

text.description: The sections run together as plain text; what a reviewer signs and what the HIS receives as a `DocumentReference`.

missingOrConflictingFacts.description: What the draft reported as missing, stale or contradictory, for a person to resolve.

humanReviewRequired.description: Whether a person must review this before it can be used. Always `true` while the status is `Draft`.

draftedBy.description: Name of the AI provider that produced the draft.

modelDeployment.description: The model deployment that produced the draft.

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt and template used, so a reviewer can tell two drafts apart.

trigger.description: Why the draft was produced: because a person asked, or because a handoff was proposed.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag the summary is written in.

approvedBy.description: Reference of the person who approved it; `null` unless the status is `Approved`.

approvedAt.description: When it was approved; `null` unless the status is `Approved`.

rejectedBy.description: Reference of the person who rejected it; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

rejectedAt.description: When it was rejected; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

rejectionReason.description: Why the reviewer rejected it; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

HandoffSummaryResponse.description: A handoff summary for a case, returned when one is drafted, approved or rejected.

HandoffSummaryStatus.description: Where a handoff summary stands with its reviewer.

status.description: Always `ok` when the service is able to answer.

service.description: Name of the service that answered.

openCases.description: Number of cases not yet closed.

closedCases.description: Number of cases closed with evidence or a documented exception.

casesByStage.description: Number of open cases per stage name.

casesByException.description: Number of open cases per unresolved exception name.

overdueCases.description: Number of open cases past their deadline.

unassignedCases.description: Number of open cases in the facility lead queue with no named owner.

closureRate.description: Share of cases closed, from 0 to 1; `null` when there are no cases.

medianTimeToClosure.description: Median time from result received to closure; `null` when no case is closed.

measures.description: Rates keyed by measure: acknowledgement, closure, understanding, nextStepOnTime, referralAcceptedAndAttended, appointmentsAttended, treatmentStartedOnTime and signedEvidence.

timeToStep.description: Elapsed clock-time medians keyed by acknowledgement, consultation, appointment, careStarted and closure.

closuresByReason.description: Closed cases per authorized typed closure reason.

casesReachingDisplayLabel.description: Cases that actually reached each display label in an applied audit projection; no skipped labels are inferred.

casesByDisplayLabel.description: Current cases per Domain display label.

confidenceRate.description: Share of notified cases that supplied a confidence rating; null when none were notified.

confidenceDenominator.description: Number of notified cases eligible to supply a confidence rating.

confidenceResponses.description: Number of cases supplying a rating.

averageConfidence.description: Mean latest rating, 1 to 5; null when no rating was supplied.

workstream.description: The workstream that will implement the endpoint, for example `WS6`.

feature.description: The slice that is not implemented yet.

message.description: A short explanation for whoever called the endpoint.

NotImplementedResponse.description: Body returned with HTTP 501 by endpoints that are scaffolded but not yet implemented.

reference.description: Source-system reference of the person, or the queue identifier.

facilityId.description: The facility the owner belongs to.

isQueue.description: `true` when the owner is the facility lead queue rather than a named person.

OwnerResponse.description: The person or queue accountable for a case, as shown in the dashboard.

version.description: The definition version the entry describes; matches string PathwayDefinition.Version for the current entry.

date.description: The date the version was approved or, for a placeholder, drafted.

approver.description: Who approved the version. A placeholder entry names no clinical adviser and says it is unapproved.

summary.description: What changed in this version, in one or two sentences.

version.description: The current definition's version, not a historical case-version claim.

isPlaceholder.description: Whether the definition still contains clinically unapproved placeholders.

urgencyCodes.description: The reviewed urgency codes the pathway accepts.

unassignedQueueRole.description: The role accountable while a case has no named owner.

tracks.description: Tracks required for closure and their exception next actions.

deadlines.description: Deadlines with owners, citations and clinical approval status.

escalationLadder.description: Oversight steps and elapsed overdue thresholds.

closureRules.description: Authorized closure reasons and evidence requirements.

evidenceKinds.description: Recognized outcome kinds and their next actions.

ProgrammeResponse.description: The read-only, versioned pathway configuration; approvals happen outside CareLoop.

rate.description: Numerator divided by denominator, or null when no cases are eligible.

RateMeasureResponse.description: A coordination rate with its explicit population, not a clinical effectiveness claim.

reason.description: Why the reviewer turned the draft down. Stored with the rejection and read when the drafts are evaluated.

RejectSummaryRequest.description: Body of the request rejecting a drafted handoff summary.

escalationEnabled.description: `true` when deadlines and escalation were active in this arm.

closedCases.description: Number of cases closed with evidence or a documented exception by the end of the replay.

stalledCases.description: Number of cases left without action past their deadline and never picked up.

medianTimeToClosure.description: Median time from result received to closure; `null` when no case closed.

SimulationArmResponse.description: The result of replaying the cohort under one condition (with or without escalation).

cohortScenario.description: Name of the cohort scenario to replay, for example `cohort`.

seed.description: Random seed overriding the scenario's own, so a run can be repeated exactly; `null` uses the scenario's seed.

cohortScenario.description: Name of the cohort scenario that was replayed.

seed.description: The seed used, so the run can be repeated.

withEscalation.description: The arm with deadlines and escalation active.

withoutEscalation.description: The arm with deadlines and escalation switched off.

SourceEventDisposition.description: What CareLoop did with a source event.

leavesOn.description: The event types that move a case out of this stage.

oneOf.description: The stage entered when one of IReadOnlyList<CaseEventType> StageDefinition.LeavesOn is applied; `null` for the final stage.

allowedRoles.description: The role keys allowed to perform the event that leaves this stage.

nextActionOnEntry.description: Key of the next action set when the stage is entered; matches a string DeadlineDefinition.NextAction.

StageDefinition.description: Entry and exit rules for one pathway stage.

sourceFactIds.description: Identifiers of the facts the section was drafted from, so a reviewer can check each statement against its source.

SummarySectionResponse.description: One section of a handoff summary and the facts it rests on.

sourceSystem.description: The source system joined from the stored event; internal events use careloop.

disposition.description: Whether the event was applied or refused (for example a closure attempt without evidence).

actorReference.description: The source system or actor responsible. For the coordinator, `(hidden)` where it would name the patient.

actorRole.description: The role the actor acted in.

sourceTimestamp.description: When the action happened according to the source.

oneOf.description: The stage before the event; `null` when the event opened the case.

reason.description:
Why the change was made or refused. For the coordinator, any identifier of the patient or of a hospital record
that the wording quotes reads `(hidden)`.

evidenceReference.description: Reference to the supporting evidence, when there is any. `null` for the coordinator, who sees no one's identity.

origin.description:
Where the entry came from: `hospital` (the case's source system), `careloop` (CareLoop itself, including
a call a nurse recorded), `sms` or `email` (a delivery report or the patient's reply on that channel).

TimelineEntryResponse.description: One audit entry in a case timeline, returned by `GET /cases/{caseId}/timeline`.

requiredForClosure.description: `true` when the track must be complete before closure on a non-exception reason.

nextActionOnException.description: Key of the next action created when the track hits an exception (failed, rejected, missed).

TrackDefinition.description: How a pathway uses one of the parallel tracks.

TrackKind.description: Identifies one of the parallel follow-up tracks of a case.

status.description: The track's status name, for example `Delivered` or `Accepted`; `null` when the track has not started.

isComplete.description: `true` when the track has reached its completing status. Delivery alone does not complete notification; an accepted referral is still not completed care.

updatedAt.description: When the track last changed; `null` when it has not started.

TrackStatusResponse.description: The current state of one parallel track of a case.
